policy.sourceControl: This monorepo is authoritative only for the applications listed in this contract. Standalone FMB applications may have separate canonical repositories; FMB News is explicitly external at masinlocandher-max/FMBNews.
policy.deployment: One independently configured Vercel project per application boundary listed here. FMB News is excluded and deploys independently through Cloudflare from masinlocandher-max/FMBNews.
policy.data: No production database, authentication tenant, service-role key, or private environment variable may be shared across FMB/Yoni, SENZ, and Cognita unless explicitly approved and documented.
